question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, along with the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string length for that same port status among ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address in ('10.150.64.113/8'). Include subtotals per port status and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_ports AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner,
    sa.updated_at AS sa_updated_at
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
      WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
),
port_stats AS (
  SELECT
    port_status,
    device_owner,
    COUNT(port_id) AS port_count,
    MIN(sa_updated_at) AS earliest_sa_update
  FROM base_ports
  GROUP BY port_status, device_owner
),
cv_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.status AS port_status,
    STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS cv_ip_length
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1
    AND ia.ip_address IN ('10.150.64.113/8')
  GROUP BY p.status
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ps.port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
       WHEN GROUPING(ps.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
       ELSE ps.port_status END AS port_status,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ps.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
       ELSE ps.device_owner END AS device_owner,
  SUM(ps.port_count) AS port_count,
  MIN(ps.earliest_sa_update) AS earliest_sa_update,
  cv.cv_ip_length
FROM port_stats ps
LEFT JOIN cv_stats cv ON cv.port_status = ps.port_status
GROUP BY ps.port_status, ps.device_owner, cv.cv_ip_length
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ps.port_status) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  ps.port_status,
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(ps.device_owner) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  ps.device_owner
